All signs point to Siri AI arriving on HomePod through new hardware, and leaker pdfu shared today what the new Siri might look like on HomePod.

HomePod 27's code includes support for Siri AI, along with a redesigned status indicator light

Apple never discusses future products, but market rumours circulating for months suggest Siri AI will land on the upcoming new Apple TV 4K and HomePod devices.

When Apple launched Siri AI in June, it made no mention whatsoever of this assistant being applied to tvOS or HomePod software. Many believe this is because the new version of Siri requires new hardware that has yet to be announced.

Leaker pdfu has posted on X, giving us what may be our first glimpse of Siri AI running on HomePod. Here is the post and video:

As the post notes, the HomePod 27 software already contains the code needed to run Siri AI, but it has not yet been enabled for users.

In a follow-up post, pdfu clarified that it remains uncertain whether Siri AI will be limited to new hardware only, but it looks almost certain.

If Apple had intended to bring Siri AI to older HomePod models, they would very likely have announced this feature back in June. The company's complete silence on Siri AI for the Home product line strongly hints that there will be strict hardware requirements.

What are your thoughts on the design of the new Siri AI on HomePod? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
